seo.title: Private Massage in Lanzarote | Carolina Massage Lanzarote
seo.description: Private massage experiences in Lanzarote, including volcanic hot stone, relaxing and therapeutic massage, with mobile service for hotels, villas and holiday apartments.

hero.title: Slow down. Release tension. Enjoy Lanzarote differently.
hero.body: Personalised massage treatments designed around how you feel, in a private setting or brought directly to your hotel, villa or holiday apartment.

intro.title: Your holiday is also a chance to stop.
intro.body: After travelling, exploring the island or simply moving at a different rhythm, your body may be asking for a pause. Each session is adapted to how you feel that day, with attentive, unhurried care.

signature.title: Volcanic Hot Stone Massage
signature.body: A personalised manual massage combined with the warmth of volcanic stones to encourage deep relaxation and release everyday tension. The experience finishes with a gentle facial and scalp massage.

servicesHeading.title: Choose what your body needs today.
servicesHeading.body: Not sure which treatment is right for you? Tell Carolina how you feel and she will help you choose.

services.name: Relaxing Massage
services.description: A slow, calming massage created to release everyday tension and help you fully switch off.

services.name: Therapeutic Massage
services.description: A more focused session adapted to areas where you are carrying tension or discomfort.

services.name: Neck & Shoulder Massage
services.description: Targeted attention for one of the areas where travel, stress and daily tension often accumulate.

services.name: Back Massage
services.description: Focused work designed to leave the back feeling lighter, more comfortable and cared for.

mobile.title: Your massage. Your space.
mobile.body: Staying in a hotel, private villa or holiday apartment? Carolina can bring the massage experience directly to you, so you can relax without interrupting your day.
mobile.note: Available in selected areas of Lanzarote. Location and availability are confirmed before booking.

about.title: Personal care makes the difference.
about.body: Every massage begins with listening. Carolina adapts each session to how you feel, the areas that need attention and the experience you are looking for, creating a calm, private and personal space for your time in Lanzarote.
about.note: Professional background and qualifications can be added here once confirmed.

reviews.title: Trust is part of the experience.
reviews.body: Verified Google reviews will be displayed here as they become available.

finalCta.title: Tell Carolina where you are staying and what you need.
finalCta.body: She will personally confirm availability and help you choose the right massage experience. Appointments are available daily from 10:00 to 21:00 with prior booking.
finalCta.message: Hello Carolina, I’m visiting Lanzarote and would like to book a massage. I’m staying in… My preferred date and time are…
